title: German-Style Saltimbocca Liver with Intense Italian Flair
description: A creative twist on the classic Italian dish, Saltimbocca, with a German spin using liver and intense flavors.
instructions: Season the veal liver with salt and black pepper.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the liver slices for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Remove the liver from the skillet and set aside.
Add the thinly sliced prosciutto to the skillet and cook until crispy.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until reduced.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Return the liver to the skillet and simmer until cooked through.
Serve the liver with the prosciutto and onion mixture spooned over the top.
